newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ICN offers buyout for Alkaloida shares.
newsitem.headline: ICN offers buyout for Alkaloida shares.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals, majority owner of Hungarian pharmaceuticals company ICN Alkaloida Rt, made a buyout offer for shares of the company, it said in a statement in the official bourse gazette.
ICN offers to pay 57 percent of the face value of Alkaloida shares or 570 forints per 1,000 forint share, it said, adding that the offer will be valid from July 15 to April 30, 1998.
ICN bought a 50.02 percent stake in Alkaloida, paying $9.11 million or 57 percent of the face value of the stake in June 1996. Later last year it raised its stake via increasing Alkaloida's capital.
The state will retain a 25 percent plus one vote stake in Alkaloida which was granted a 35-year exclusive licence for the production of opium derivatives and psychotropic drugs in 1993.
Alkaloida shares trade on Hungary's over-the-countrer market, with brokers bidding 50-52 percent of the face value and offering 61-68 percent.
